findings.problem: The hint rules out wirklich but not aber, the other common particle of surprise: Das ist aber toll! is just as right as Das ist ja toll!, and the adverb echt also fits.
findings.fix: hint: particle of surprise, not aber, echt or wirklich

back.target: (modal particle) expressing surprise or a shared obvious fact; roughly oh, really, after all

note: English has no real word for this ja, so the bracketed [really] is only a rough stand-in, and the hint does most of the work.
